doc.summary: Graphical sudo askpass helpers for desktop sudo prompts.
doc.description:
The LazyNmap scan verb needs root for SYN scans. On a desktop session a
terminal password prompt is hostile; this module resolves a graphical
askpass helper (an installed ksshaskpass/ssh-askpass build, or a generated
zenity/yad helper) so ``sudo -A`` shows a GUI password dialog instead.

The module never blocks: when no display server and no helper are
available every function degrades to an empty string and the caller keeps
its existing sudo flow.

doc.summary: Return whether a graphical display server is reachable.
doc.description:
Checks ``DISPLAY`` and ``WAYLAND_DISPLAY`` so Wayland-only desktops
are recognised as well.

returns.description: True when a display server appears available.

doc.summary: Return the first installed native askpass helper, empty when none.
doc.description:
Order honours KDE and LXQt branded helpers first, then the generic
OpenSSH X11 helper and macOS equivalent. Paths outside ``PATH`` are
probed explicitly because some distributions install the OpenSSH
helper outside the PATH.

returns.description: Absolute path to a helper binary or an empty string.

doc.summary: Write a temporary askpass helper backed by zenity or yad.
doc.description:
The helper prints a password-entry dialog to stdout, which is the
``SUDO_ASKPASS`` contract. The script is written to a per-user temp
directory with mode 0700 and no secrets embedded.

returns.description:
Path to the helper script, empty when neither zenity nor yad is
installed or the write fails.

doc.summary: Return the best graphical askpass helper path, empty when unusable.
doc.description:
Resolution order: explicit ``LAZYOWN_ASKPASS`` override, an installed
native helper, then a generated zenity/yad helper.

returns.description: Helper path string, empty when no graphical prompt is possible.

doc.summary: Return whether a graphical sudo prompt can be shown right now.

returns.description: True when a display server and an askpass helper both exist.

doc.summary: Return the environment variables that route sudo through the GUI.

returns.description:
Mapping with ``SUDO_ASKPASS`` (and ``LAZYOWN_ASKPASS`` mirrored)
when a graphical helper is available, otherwise empty.

name: sudo_graphical_requested
signature: def sudo_graphical_requested(payload: dict | None = None) -> bool

doc.summary: Return whether the operator asked for graphical sudo prompts.
doc.description:
Reads the ``sudo_graphical`` payload flag; defaults to True on
desktop sessions so an interactive shell asks through the GUI and
the unattended loop never does.

params.name: payload
params.description: Loaded payload mapping; loaded lazily when omitted.

returns.description: True when graphical sudo prompts are requested.
